about.title: About Grand Azure
about.description: At Grand Azure Hotel, we redefine luxury hospitality on the coast. Since 2015, we have welcomed over 50,000 guests from around the world, offering premium accommodations, world-class dining, and unforgettable experiences.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To create exceptional experiences where every guest feels valued, relaxed, and inspired by the beauty around them.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the most beloved coastal destination, setting the standard for sustainable luxury hospitality worldwide.

heritage.title: Our Heritage
heritage.text: Built on a historic waterfront site, our hotel blends timeless architecture with modern luxury amenities.

amenitiesPage.title: Hotel Amenities
amenitiesPage.subtitle: Everything you need for a perfect stay

list.title: Infinity Pool
list.description: Rooftop infinity pool with panoramic ocean views, open sunrise to sunset.
list.overview: Immerse yourself in our temperature-controlled infinity pool that appears to merge seamlessly with the sparkling ocean horizon. Complete with private rental cabanas, sun lounge chairs, and poolside cocktail service.
rules: Appropriate swimwear is required at all times.
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.
No glass containers or bottles near the pool deck.
Showers are required before pool entry.
list.price: Complimentary for hotel guests | Cabana rental: $50/hour

list.title: Azure Spa
list.description: Full-service spa with massage therapy, facials, and wellness treatments.
list.overview: Embark on a relaxing wellness journey at the Azure Spa. We offer classic hot stone massages, therapeutic facials, herbal baths, and holistic treatments designed to restore balance to your body and mind.
rules: Please arrive 15 minutes prior to your appointment.
Reservations must be cancelled at least 4 hours in advance.
Silent zone: Mobile phones must be kept on silent.
Minimum age of 16 years for spa entry.

list.title: Fitness Center
list.description: 24/7 state-of-the-art gym with personal trainers available on request.
list.overview: Keep up with your fitness routine while enjoying floor-to-ceiling garden views. Equipped with state-of-the-art cardio decks, free weights, resistance cable machinery, and private personal training support rooms.
rules: Proper athletic wear and closed shoes are mandatory.
Please wipe down machinery after usage (towels provided).
Re-rack weights and returns bars after training.
Max occupancy is capped at 25 concurrent training guests.
list.price: Complimentary for hotel guests | Personal trainer: $80/hour

list.title: Sky Lounge Bar
list.description: Rooftop bar with craft cocktails, live music, and sunset views.
list.overview: Watch the sunset paint the sea while sipping custom mixology cocktails. Featuring fire pits, velvet lounge sofa booths, live lounge acoustic sets, and small bite platters.
rules: Smart casual dress code (no swimwear or sandals after 7 PM).
Table reservations highly recommended on weekends.
Age restriction: 21+ only after 09:00 PM.
Please notify servers of any food/beverage allergies.
list.price: Cocktails from $18 | Happy Hour: 5-7 PM (50% off select drinks)

list.title: Fine Dining
list.description: Award-winning restaurant serving international and local cuisine.
list.overview: Dine in under glittering crystal chandeliers. Our restaurant features seasonal tasting menus, premium steak cuts, fresh catches of the day, and a curated wine list with over 500 options.
rules: Semi-formal dress code requested.
Reservations requested for dinner service.
Kids menus are available upon request.
Private dining alcoves can be pre-reserved.
list.price: Mains from $45 | Tasting menu: $120/person (wine pairing extra)

list.title: High-Speed WiFi
list.description: Complimentary fiber-optic WiFi throughout the entire property.
list.overview: Stay connected with high-speed fiber-optic wireless networks. Enjoy seamless speed capabilities in your suite, near the pool, in lounges, or inside dining halls.
rules: Use guest portals to log in using room numbers.
Basic level bandwidth is free; premium tiers can be purchased.
Complimentary technical assistance via concierge hotline.
No unauthorized downloads on public subnet access gates.
list.price: Complimentary up to 100 Mbps | Premium: $20/day for 500 Mbps

list.title: Valet Parking
list.description: Complimentary valet parking and electric vehicle charging stations.
list.overview: Sleek and secure drop-off/pick-up services. Hand over your vehicle keys at the portico and let our secure attendants handle parking, battery charging, and luggage unloading.
rules: Present your valet ticket stub to request your vehicle.
Expect 10-15 minutes retrieval delay during checkout peaks.
Valet service is complimentary for all registered suite guests.
Electric charging bays require pre-arrival slot reservation.

list.title: 24/7 Concierge
list.description: Personal concierge for reservations, tours, and special requests.
list.overview: Let us curate your dream coastal itinerary. We coordinate taxi dispatch, local theater tickets, private dining reservations, helicopter tours, and custom luggage shipping.
rules: Advance notices requested for custom tour operations.
Direct dial 0 from any room telephone to reach desk.
Gratuity is optional and at the discretion of the guest.
Shipping items must match standard postal security requirements.
list.price: Complimentary consultation | Tour bookings have separate fees
